Commit messages in this repo are clean, short and human in style: no Co-Authored-By trailer, no generated-with footer, no verbose multi-paragraph bodies. Write a concise message - ideally a single subject line, with one or two short body lines only if genuinely needed - and omit all AI attribution even where global tooling defaults suggest adding them.
